nodes.label: What v1.0.0 is — single-user, locally-trusted desktop system of record for a small engineering consultancy
nodes.rationale: Five sentences: open a client project; record evidence; independent check and issue; record time and emit an invoice request; see utilisation, margin, WIP and DSO. Everything kept serves one of them; everything else is frozen, archived or deleted.
